# Security reports

This repository is an independent Satellite fork. For a vulnerability introduced
by Satellite, contact the fork maintainer through their
[GitHub profile](https://github.com/RobertScholey98) to arrange private disclosure.
Do not put credentials or exploit details in a public issue.

For vulnerabilities in upstream T3 Code or T3-operated services, use
[upstream's security policy](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/security/policy).
T3 Tools does not operate this fork.
